\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.text}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[gray!35] (0,-.25) rectangle (4.5,1.2);
  % The PGF manual's W{\kern-1ptA}TER: the kern is inside A's rigid box.
  \path[decorate,decoration={text along path,text={W{\kern-1ptA}TER {office} {AV}}}]
    (.15,.62) -- (4.2,.62);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text along path,text={WATER office AV}}]
    (.15,.02) -- (4.2,.02);
\end{tikzpicture}
